title: LossRunDocument
description: Canonical workers' compensation loss run: one document (one carrier/TPA run at one valuation date) -> policy periods -> claims, plus printed subtotals and grand totals. Values only; per-value lineage is keyed by field path in `lineage`. Source: docs/evaluation/evaluation-and-wc-domain.md B1 (schema + aliases), B2 (enumerations), B4 (totals used by reconciliation rules).

schemaVersion.description: Version of this schema the document conforms to (semver; matches the top-level `schemaVersion` keyword of this file).

documentId.description: Stable id of the source document (blob id / content hash) this canonical record was extracted from.

carrierName.description: Issuing carrier as printed on the run (letterhead/header).

tpaName.description: Third-party administrator, when the run is a TPA run (State Fund requires TPA letterhead).

insuredName.description: Named insured / employer the run is for.

lineOfBusiness.description: Line of business of the run as a whole. Canonical `WC`; anything else is flagged by the non-WC rule.

jurisdictionState.description: Default jurisdiction (2-letter USPS state) for claims that do not print their own.

valuationDate.description: Valuation ('as of') date of the money on the run. Drives staleness (State Fund: within 100 days of inception) and DOI ordering.

valuationDateSource.description: Brief 23 Answers 2: where the valuation date comes from: printed on the run, or stated by the submitter because the run prints none (lineage extractor context). R-32 flags submission; the quote payload and the pricing memo state it.

reportRunDate.description: Date the report was produced/printed, when different from the valuation date.

noLossesStatement.description: True when the run prints an explicit 'no losses reported' / 'NONE' statement.

unattributedNoLossesStatement.description: A 'no losses' statement was printed but could not be tied to a policy period: every period lists claims (ADR 0016 as amended in ADR 0018). Flagged by R-28; it usually means a period heading was not read.

componentPresence.description: Loss components the run does not print at all (brief 19 Answers 1; ADR 0018 amendment): e.g. medical { present: false } for a carrier whose loss run has no medical column. Not zero and not null: the source does not report it. The learn gate does not require an absent component; analytics marks metrics that use it as computed without it. Null when every component is printed or unknown.

totalComposition.description: What the printed total columns sum (ADR 0018): `allComponents` (indemnity + medical + expense; R-20) or `indemnityMedical` (a total headed e.g. 'Total Incurred (Ind+Med)' beside separate expense columns; R-29). Null when the format names no composition, read as allComponents.

expenseTreatment.description: How the run treats expense/ALAE, set from the carrier format spec (brief 05): `separate` (own columns), `mergedIntoMedical` (folded into medical), `excluded` (not on the run), `unknown`. Drives R-20 severity and like-for-like metrics.

policyPeriods.description: Policy periods printed on the run, each with its claims and printed subtotals.

reportTotals.description: Grand totals printed for the whole run (null when the run prints none).

lineage.description: Per-value lineage keyed by canonical field path (e.g. `policyPeriods[0].claims[2].indemnity.paid`). Same path format as RuleOutcome.affectedFields.

PolicyPeriod.description: One policy term on the run.

carrierName.description: Carrier for this term when a run spans carriers; otherwise null (inherit document carrier).

periodKind.description: What the period is (ADR 0017): `policyTerm` for a policy term (the default reading of a loss run), or the year a summary row reports by -- `fiscalYear`, `reportYear`, `accidentYear`, `calendarYear`. Null when not printed or not determinable.

periodLabel.description: The period's printed label when it is not a policy number or a date range (e.g. a fiscal or report year as printed; ADR 0017).

noLossesStatement.description: True when this period prints an explicit 'no claims' / 'no losses' statement (ADR 0016). R-14 then requires zero claim rows for the period; a period with zero rows and no statement is flagged by R-27.

detailLevel.description: `claims` when the run lists claim rows for this term, or prints a no-losses statement for it (ADR 0016); `summaryOnly` when it prints only totals/counts (research B1 layout archetype 3; ADR 0017: a summary-only loss run is a document whose periods are all summary-only). Reconciliation rules R-10/R-11 are not applicable to summary-only terms.

claims.description: Claim rows printed under this term.

keptRows.description: Brief 23 §2 (ADR 0020 amendment): rows of another line of business printed under this term (a line or claim-type code naming auto, general liability, …). Kept, not extracted: listed with keptReason, counted, never in claims, metrics or the quote payload. R-10/R-11 tie the claims plus these rows to a printed subtotal that covers every line.

subtotals.description: Subtotal block printed for this term (null when none printed).

Claim.description: One claim row (one claim at the document's valuation date).

claimNumber.description: Carrier/TPA claim number as printed (normalized only by CanonicalComparer for matching).

claimantName.description: Injured worker name. PII: strip before any LLM call the schema does not need it for.

dateOfInjury.description: Date of injury / loss / accident. For CA cumulative trauma, the Lab. Code §5412 date (may post-date employment).

dateReported.description: Date reported to carrier / claim administrator.

dateClosed.description: Close date (for reopened claims, the most recent prior close date if printed).

lastDayWorked.description: The claimant's last day worked, when the carrier prints it. Drives post-termination cumulative-trauma flags (CA LC 3600(a)(10)); the submission context's account-level date applies when absent.

status.description: Canonical claim status. Reopened counts as open for open/closed counts. `unknown` (brief 19 Answers 2): the format prints no status and its close dates were not verified as a status convention; neither open nor closed, flagged by R-30.

rawStatus.description: Status exactly as printed (e.g. 'Closed in subrogation', 'O', 'L'), kept for audit and re-mapping.

claimType.description: Medical-only vs indemnity (lost time). Derived from injury type code when printed (06/07 -> medicalOnly), else from indemnity money; `unknown` when neither is available.

injuryTypeCode.description: Statistical-plan injury type code when printed (code-sets.json `statPlan.injuryType`).

typeOfLossCode.description: Statistical-plan type of loss: 01 trauma, 02 cumulative occupational disease, 03 cumulative other (code-sets.json `statPlan.typeOfLoss`).

cumulativeTrauma.description: True when the claim is cumulative trauma (type of loss 02/03, WCIO nature 60-83, cause 97/98, or 'CT'/'cumulative' text). Changes DOI rule severity (CA LC 5412).

natureOfInjury.description: Nature of injury: WCIO code and/or free text.

causeOfInjury.description: Cause of injury: WCIO code and/or free text.

partOfBody.description: Part of body: WCIO code and/or free text.

accidentDescription.description: Free-text accident/loss description. May contain PHI.

litigationFlag.description: Litigated / attorney-represented. Provenance matters: explicit column > status text > attorney-fee column > legal expense > 0 (weak).

reportOnly.description: Recorded for reporting only, without financials (brief 22 Answers 4): a census-only status (Travelers 'X') or an incident indicator. Status says whether the claim is open; this flag says whether it carries amounts. Claim counts report both totals (with and without report-only claims).

keptReason.description: Brief 23 §2: on a row in a period's keptRows only, why it was kept, not extracted ('line of business: auto (claim-type code "PP")').

jurisdictionState.description: Claim jurisdiction (2-letter USPS state); falls back to the document jurisdiction when null.

classCode.description: Payroll classification code. CA: 4-digit WCIRB code, left-zero padded, base code only.

lineOfBusiness.description: Line of business when the run mixes lines per row (e.g. WC / EL / GL / AL); falls back to the document line.

indemnity.description: Indemnity (wage replacement, incl. death benefits) paid/reserve/incurred.

medical.description: Medical paid/reserve/incurred. Some carriers merge expense/ALAE into medical; see report 03 open questions.

expense.description: Expense / ALAE (legal, other claim-specific expense; rehab is folded in until a separate bucket is needed).

total.description: Total paid/reserve/incurred as printed (gross of recoveries). Not computed: when not printed it stays null.

recoverySubrogation.description: Subrogation / third-party / salvage recoveries, as a positive amount recovered.

netIncurred.description: Net incurred (gross incurred less recoveries) when printed. CA experience rating uses net for subrogated claims.

MoneyTriplet.description: Paid to date, case reserve (outstanding), incurred (paid + reserve). Each value as printed; null when the column is absent.

CodedValue.description: A code-set value: the code (if printed or mapped), the raw text, and the code system it belongs to.

codeSystem.description: Code system id from code-sets.json (e.g. `WCIO-Nature`, `WCIO-Cause`, `WCIO-PartOfBody`) or `carrier:<id>` for carrier-specific codes.

Totals.description: A printed subtotal or grand-total block.

openCount.description: Printed open claim count (reopened counted as open).

recoverySubrogation.description: Subrogation recoveries (the recovery kind claim rows carry; ADR 0017 keeps it here and adds the other kinds under `recoveries`).

recoveries.description: Recoveries other than subrogation, by kind, as a summary or total row prints them (ADR 0017; P5). Recovery columns not modelled here are listed in glossary.json `ignoredHeaders`.

ComponentPresence.description: Per loss component: { present: false } when the run prints no column for it (brief 19 Answers 1). A component not listed is printed or unknown.

Presence.description: Whether the source reports a component.

present.description: False: the run prints no column for the component.

RecoveryAmounts.description: Recovery amounts by kind (ADR 0017). Subrogation is `recoverySubrogation` on the owning totals or claim.

other.description: Other recoveries the run prints as a separate column.

LineageRecord.description: Where one canonical value came from (CLAUDE.md: document id, page + polygon or sheet + cell, format version, model/prompt version, confidence).

polygon.description: Bounding polygon on the page (x1,y1,...,x4,y4; inches for PDF, pixels for images, per CU/DI geometry).

sourceText.description: Raw text of the source cell/span before normalization.

extractor.description: How the value was produced: replay (deterministic read through a CarrierFormat), derived (computed by a format's derivedRules from other values), spec (constant declared by the format), context (taken from the submission, e.g. the carrier hint on a letterhead-less export), learn / delta (model-assisted, brief 06), manual (reviewer edit).

model.description: Model deployment name when a model produced or mapped the value; null for deterministic replay.

promptVersion.description: Prompt/spec version when a model was involved.

part.description: For a value read from a stacked cell (two fields printed in one cell, ADR 0018): its 0-based position in the cell. Null for a whole cell.

repair.description: A repair replay applied to the printed text, which sourceText keeps as printed (brief 31 Answers 1): ocrRepair: l→I for a scanned Title-Case name whose first capital I OCR read as l. Null when the value is the printed text.
